Real_Verifier_Authority.description: FileExists, FileContent, ProtectedPath verifiers → Evidence → M6-A

E2E-1.name: success_all_verifiers_pass
E2E-1.description: Agent creates correct file → all 3 verifiers pass → Success+Commit

E2E-2.name: content_error_rollback
E2E-2.description: Agent creates wrong content → FileExists passes, FileContent fails → Failed+Rollback

E2E-3.name: unauthorized_modification
E2E-3.description: Agent modifies protected path → ProtectedPathVerifier fails → not Committed

E2E-4.name: verifier_env_vs_unsat
E2E-4.description: Missing file is UNSAT (task failure), not EnvironmentError

E2E-6.name: post_verification_tamper
E2E-6.description: Verification passes, then file tampered → stale evidence must not authorize commit

root_invariants_proven: Verifier pass without durable Evidence ≠ Commit allowed
Stale evidence (old manifest hash) ≠ can commit current state
Only durable Decision + current snapshot binding → CommitPermit
